findings.summary: line 384: malformed task heading "### Task 15 (operator, when found): Swap in Noah's vector master"; expected "### Task <n>: <title>" or "### Task <n> (operator): <title>"

The reference scan includes tokens.test.mjs itself, so it finds the deliberately undefined token('nope') and c-forest-bg before Task 3 defines it, making Task 2's expected PASS impossible unless test fixtures are excluded.

The prescribed tests embed six-digit hex literals in src/lib/tokens.test.mjs, with more added in Task 8, so Task 6's repository-wide no-hex guard necessarily fails unless these fixtures move outside src or avoid literal hex strings.
Requiring every v4 declaration value to belong to the hex-only V4_PALETTE rejects the three required font-family declarations, so this test must restrict validation to colour properties.

Task 4 omits src/components/ListenButton.jsx, whose heroStyle hard-codes Big Shoulders Display, leaving the About page's Listen action outside the font tokens and breaking the promised v4 font coverage.

ShareSheet also passes PAPER directly as html2canvas's backgroundColor option, which requires a resolved colour rather than var(), so following this instruction breaks image export while the prescribed open-sheet screenshot never exercises that path.
